content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends engaging in at least 150 minutes per week of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise. Alternatively, individuals may perform 75 minutes per week of vigorous-intensity aerobic exercise. These activities should be distributed over a minimum of three days per week, ensuring that no more than two consecutive days pass without physical activity. For younger individuals or those who are more physically fit, shorter durations of high-intensity exercise, with a minimum of 75 minutes per week, may also be appropriate.
